chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Abbad ibn Ya'qub, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya, from Abu Abdillah, from his father, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), that the first person to establish two mudds of wheat as equivalent to one sa' of dates was Uthman.
ai.seo_question: Who established the equivalence between wheat and dates for Zakat al-Fitr?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar attributes the specific legal precedent of equating two mudds of wheat to one sa' of dates for Zakat al-Fitr to Caliph Uthman ibn Affan, highlighting the role of early caliphal practice (Sunnah al-Khulafa) in shaping Shia jurisprudence. It underscores the historical development of measurement standards for alms, reflecting the practical application of prophetic traditions during the Rashidun era. This attribution is significant in discussions regarding the validity of Uthman's contributions to Islamic law within Shia scholarly tradition.
